nameOfQualification: BIO GAS PLANT AND BIO SLURRY TECHNICIAN
description: Under Bio Gas Plant and Bio slurry Technician , trade a candidate is trained on Professional Skill, Professional Knowledge, Entrepreneurship skill and Employability Skill. In these days of Global Warming from industrial agriculture coupled with ever increasing cost of cultivation with dwindling farmer profit and Self-Declared Goal (SDG) of the country to work for clean technologies, Biogas Pant and Bio slurry management in Agriculture and fishery can work as a potential sustainable tool and create sustainable job opportunities at village level for the rural youth in Biogas Plant construction, maintenance as well as sustainable agriculture. Youth can become wage employed/ self-employed with the skill set of Bio Gas Plant construction, maintenance and bio slurry production.
awardingBodyName: West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Work in real job situation with special emphasis on basic safety and hazards in this domain.
Demonstrate the procedure of Bio slurry manure making and Marketing of Organically grown crops
Carry out post BGP construction activities
Construct a Bio Gas Plant with proper care and safety
Identify appropriate site for installing the BGP
Explain the process of Biomass Gasifiers
Identify Biomass resource and Bio-energy potential

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONPURSUING: Pursuing continuous schooling in regular school with vocational subject

verticalPathName: 1. Sr. Bio Gas Plant Technician, 2. Bio Gas Plant Manager
